pregunta: Por tienda, ¿cuál es el ingreso neto de Electric Bikes dividido entre el número de órdenes que lo incluyen?
sql:
SELECT 
  s.store_name AS tienda,
  ROUND(SUM(net_amount) / COUNT(*), 2) AS ingreso_neto
FROM 
  v_order_lines vl
  JOIN v_orders v ON vl.order_id = v.order_id
  JOIN stocks st ON vl.product_id = st.product_id
  JOIN products p ON st.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN stores s ON st.store_id = s.store_id
WHERE 
  v.order_status = 4
  AND s.store_name = 'Baldwin Bikes'
  AND strftime('%Y', vl.order_date) = '2016'
GROUP BY 
  s.store_name
ORDER BY 
  ingreso_neto DESC
LIMIT 500

SELECT 
  s.store_name AS tienda,
  SUM(ol.list_price * ol.quantity) AS total_gasto,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS clientes,
  ROUND(AVG(ol.list_price * ol.quantity), 2) AS ticket_promedio
FROM 
  v_order_lines ol
  JOIN v_order_lines o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN products p ON ol.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
WHERE 
  o.order_status = 4
GROUP BY 
  s.store_name
ORDER BY 
  ticket_promedio DESC
LIMIT 1
